<!-- codex-harness:begin -->
A delegated worker performs only its bounded assignment and never starts this coordinator.
For coding, UI/document creation/revision and feedback, or Web search/research, invoke Node.js 22+ on
`/skill/runtime.js` with arguments `status --project .`, quoting
its path for the active shell. Also check status for pure ideation, strategy consultation,
and criticism of proposals. If inactive, continue normally without additional harness
actions. If active, read `/skill/SKILL.md` and follow its relevant
instructions. Pure creative work and Web-only research do not require coding delegation or Git steps.
Pure ideation, consultation and criticism alone do not require implementation approval.
Honor higher-priority environment and project instructions. If the skill is absent, continue normally.
If status fails, report the configuration or compatibility error; do not activate features silently.
<!-- codex-harness:end -->
